<thought>The ^1H NMR shows three singlet signals with integrations of 3 H, 6 H, and 6 H. Each methyl (CH₃) contributes 3 protons, so the 3 H signal corresponds to one CH₃, and each 6 H signal corresponds to two equivalent CH₃ groups. Summing them gives 1 + 2 + 2 = 5 methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
